mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_memory SET memory_count = memory_count + 1, review_step = #{schedule.reviewStep}, review_count = #{schedule.reviewNumber}, first_learned_at = COALESCE(first_learned_at, #{schedule.reviewedAt}), last_reviewed_at = #{schedule.reviewedAt}, last_memory_at = #{schedule.reviewedAt}, next_review_at = #{schedule.nextReviewAt}, learning_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND word_id = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_english_vocabulary_memory (account_id, word_id, memory_count, review_step, review_count, first_learned_at, last_reviewed_at, next_review_at, learning_status, last_memory_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{wordId}, #{memoryCount}, #{reviewStep}, #{reviewCount}, #{firstLearnedAt}, #{lastReviewedAt}, #{nextReviewAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{lastMemoryAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memory_count = GREATEST(memory_count, VALUES(memory_count)), review_step = GREATEST(review_step, VALUES(review_step)), review_count = GREATEST(review_count, VALUES(review_count)), learning_status = 'ACTIVE', first_learned_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(first_learned_at) IS NULL THEN first_learned_at WHEN first_learned_at IS NULL OR VALUES(first_learned_at) < first_learned_at THEN VALUES(first_learned_at) ELSE first_learned_at END, last_reviewed_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_reviewed_at) IS NULL THEN last_reviewed_at WHEN last_reviewed_at IS NULL OR VALUES(last_reviewed_at) > last_reviewed_at THEN VALUES(last_reviewed_at) ELSE last_reviewed_at END, last_memory_at = CASE WHEN VALUES(last_memory_at) IS NULL THEN last_memory_at WHEN last_memory_at IS NULL OR VALUES(last_memory_at) > last_memory_at THEN VALUES(last_memory_at) ELSE last_memory_at END, next_review_at = COALESCE(next_review_at, VALUES(next_review_at))
